readmeMarkdown:
# Single AGY Model

An Antigravity plugin that strictly enforces **one locally configured model and reasoning effort** across Antigravity CLI (`agy`), Antigravity App, and IDE sessions. Installation takes **1 command** with zero manual config creation: on first run, the plugin automatically creates `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` from its bundled initial seed (`{"model": "gemini-4-neon", "effort": "xhigh"}`), and any later edit to that single local SSOT file takes effect immediately on the next turn without releasing, reinstalling, or restarting anything.

## Quick Install (1 Step)

```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
```

That's it. On the first session start or turn, the plugin atomically creates `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` (mode `0600`) seeded with:

```json
{"model": "gemini-4-neon", "effort": "xhigh"}
```

Once created, `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` is never overwritten by the plugin and survives plugin updates and uninstalls.

## How It Works

The plugin ships fail-closed lifecycle hooks in [`hooks.json`](hooks.json) backed by a zero-dependency Python 3.9+ standard-library guard at [`scripts/model_guard.py`](scripts/model_guard.py), a single bundled seed file at [`scripts/default_config.json`](scripts/default_config.json), and an always-on agent rule at [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md):

- **Single local SSOT config with transparent first-run bootstrap:** Resolved per the XDG Base Directory Specification (`${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/single-agy-model/config.json` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is a non-empty absolute path, otherwise `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json`). Shared identically by Antigravity App and `agy` CLI. When absent (checked via `os.lstat` without following symlinks), the guard validates `scripts/default_config.json` through the exact same strict config parser, creates the parent directory (`0700`, refusing to bootstrap into a symlinked `single-agy-model` directory), writes a unique sibling temporary file (`O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW`, mode `0600`), and publishes it atomically without overwriting via `os.link`.
- **`SessionStart` hook:** Bootstraps and validates `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` immediately when a new session opens, emitting `{}` (exit `0`, zero injected clutter) on success or an `errorMessage` step if bootstrap or validation fails.
- **`PreInvocation` hook:** Runs the same auto-bootstrap-then-load path (covering resumed conversations or sessions where `SessionStart` did not fire), derives the allowed model slug (`<model>-<effort>` when `effort` is a string, or `<model>` when `effort` is `null`), and requires an exact byte-for-byte match `modelName == allowed_slug`. Every other model, effort level, orchestrator model, subagent tier, or malformed input terminates execution **before inference** (`total_tokens == 0`, non-zero CLI exit code) by returning exit code `0` with `{"injectSteps":[{"errorMessage":{"userMessage":"..."}}],"terminationBehavior":"terminate"}`.
- **`PreToolUse` hook (matcher `^swarm$`):** Runs the same auto-bootstrap-then-load path first, verifies `toolCall.name == "swarm"`, and allows (`{"decision":"allow"}`) only when `toolCall.args.model` is omitted/`null`, `""` (inherits the coordinator's model), or strictly equal to the derived `allowed_slug`. Display names, whitespace-only strings, non-strings, wrong casing, unexpected tools, and all other models are denied with `{"decision":"deny","reason":"..."}`.
- **`PreToolUse` hook (matcher `^invoke_subagent$`):** Runs the same auto-bootstrap-then-load path first, verifies `toolCall.name == "invoke_subagent"`, and ensures subagents—including the built-in `browser` subagent, whose default prompt passes `Model: "flash"`—inherit the locked parent model. Calls already passing `Model: "inherit"` return `{"decision":"allow"}`; calls omitting `Model` or passing an alternate tier (`"flash"`, `"flash_lite"`, `"pro"`) are transparently coerced via `{"decision":"allow","overwrite":{"Model":"inherit"}}` (handling both single-call top-level `Model` args and batched `Subagents` arrays). Non-string, wrong-cased, or unrecognized `Model` values, malformed payloads, and invalid configs fail closed with `{"decision":"deny","reason":"..."}`.
- **Fail-closed shell wrapper:** Each hook prefers `/usr/bin/python3 -I` (compatible with minimal macOS Dock `PATH`) with fallback to `python3 -I`, wrapped with `|| printf '%s\n' '<fail-closed JSON>'` so interpreter crashes or missing binaries still fail closed with exit code `0`.

## Switching Your Locked Model (Live SSOT)

Edit `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` at any time (list available model slugs with `agy models`). Changes take effect immediately on the very next turn across both Antigravity App and `agy` CLI—no plugin release, reinstall, or restart required:

```sh
agy models
cat <<'EOF' > ~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json
{
  "model": "gemini-4-neon",
  "effort": "high"
}
EOF
```

Schema rules:

- `model` (required): lowercase slug matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` (for example `"gemini-4-neon"`).
- `effort` (required): lowercase slug matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$` (for example `"xhigh"` or `"high"`), **or** `null` for fixed-effort models without an effort suffix.
- Double-effort typos (such as `"model": "gemini-4-neon-xhigh"` paired with `"effort": "xhigh"`), unknown extra keys, and duplicate JSON keys are rejected fail-closed without overwriting your file.

## Installation & Management

### Validate before installing

```sh
agy plugin validate --strict https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
```

### Install globally

```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
agy plugin list --json
```

Installing globally stages the plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/single-agy-model/` and syncs it across Antigravity CLI, Antigravity App, and IDE extensions. For private GitHub repositories, ensure HTTPS Git authentication is configured (for example via `gh auth setup-git`), or clone locally and install from the checkout (or run `/plugin install <local-path>` inside an interactive `agy` session):

```sh
gh repo clone rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
agy plugin validate --strict ./single-agy-model
agy plugin install ./single-agy-model
```

### Install for a single workspace

Place the plugin directory at `<workspace>/.agents/plugins/single-agy-model/` (or reference it via `<workspace>/.agents/plugins.json`) to enforce the policy only within that project.

### Enable, disable, update, and uninstall

```sh
# Inspect installed plugins
agy plugin list
agy plugin list --json

# Temporarily disable or re-enable without uninstalling
agy plugin disable single-agy-model
agy plugin enable single-agy-model

# Update to the latest version (agy plugin does not have an update subcommand)
agy plugin uninstall single-agy-model && agy plugin install https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model

# Uninstall completely
agy plugin uninstall single-agy-model
```

Your `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json` lives outside the plugin directory and is preserved across uninstalls and updates. If you installed manually by copying into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/single-agy-model/`, remove the old directory before copying a newer version so obsolete files do not linger. You can also toggle or uninstall the plugin in the Antigravity App under **Customizations > Installed**.

## Strict Consequences & Auto-Bootstrap Tradeoff

Enabling this plugin intentionally blocks every model invocation that does not match your configured slug:

- **Deleting `config.json` re-seeds the initial default:** If you delete `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json`, the next hook invocation automatically recreates it from `scripts/default_config.json` (`{"model": "gemini-4-neon", "effort": "xhigh"}`). To temporarily pause enforcement without uninstalling, run `agy plugin disable single-agy-model` instead of deleting the config file.
- **Invalid, broken, or unwritable configs still fail closed without overwriting:** An existing malformed JSON file, broken symlink, symlinked `single-agy-model` directory (when `config.json` is absent), non-regular file (directory or FIFO), oversized file (`>64 KiB`), invalid `HOME`, or read-only config directory is **never overwritten** and terminates every turn before inference.
- **Orchestrator models are blocked:** Orchestrator selections (such as `gemini-pro-orchestrator-neon`, `gemini-pro-orchestrator`, and `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon`) resolve at runtime to separate underlying planner and executor models (for example `gemini-4-neon-high` and `gemini-4-hydrogen-*`), so they cannot satisfy a single-model lock and are terminated before inference.
- **Subagents & `/browser`:** Calls to `invoke_subagent`—including the `browser` subagent, which defaults to `Model: "flash"`—are automatically coerced to `Model: "inherit"` by the `PreToolUse` (`^invoke_subagent$`) hook so subagents run on your locked model instead of hitting a `PreInvocation` block. Any built-in or custom subagent or surface that still ignores `Model: "inherit"` and invokes another model tier is terminated before inference by `PreInvocation`. Configure custom subagents to inherit the parent model (`inherit`) and omit `model` (or pass the exact derived slug, not a display name) in `/swarm`.
- **CLI & App default model:** Set your saved CLI model via `/model` (or pass `--model <slug>`, e.g., `agy --model gemini-4-neon-xhigh`) and select the matching model in the Antigravity App model picker so default turns match your lock.

## Trusted Computing Base & Boundaries

This plugin enforces model selection inside local Antigravity CLI, Antigravity App, and IDE sessions where it is installed and enabled:

- **Remote Agents:** Sessions executed via `--remote-agent` run in a remote environment and are not governed unless both the plugin and its config file exist in that remote environment.
- **External CLIs and network tools:** Antigravity lifecycle hooks govern Antigravity's own model invocations and `swarm` calls, not external binaries launched via terminal commands (such as `claude`, `codex`, or direct API `curl` requests). To also prevent the agent from invoking external model CLIs through terminal tools, add a deny permission rule such as `command(claude)` to your Antigravity **Deny** permission list in settings.
- **Local workstation control:** Anyone (or any local process) with write access to `~/.config/single-agy-model/config.json`, `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`, or `~/.gemini/config/config.json` can change the lock or disable the plugin.

## Development, Maintenance & Releases

### Repository layout

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `plugin.json` | Antigravity plugin manifest (`https://antigravity.google/schemas/v1/plugin.json`). |
| `hooks.json` | Root-level lifecycle hooks (`SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, and `PreToolUse` on `^swarm$` and `^invoke_subagent$`). |
| `scripts/model_guard.py` | Zero-dependency Python 3.9+ stdlib guard (`0755`). |
| `scripts/default_config.json` | Single bundled initial seed (`{"model": "gemini-4-neon", "effort": "xhigh"}`) strictly validated on first-run bootstrap. |
| `rules/AGENTS.md` | Always-on plugin rule (plain Markdown, no YAML frontmatter). |
| `assets/logo.svg` | Square high-contrast plugin icon (`viewBox >= 128x128`). |
| `pyproject.toml` & `Makefile` | Strict `ruff` (`ALL`), `mypy --strict`, `basedpyright` (`strict`), `pytest`, `shellcheck`, and `agy plugin validate --strict`. |
| `tests/` | Unit/security tests (`test_model_guard.py`), `hooks.json` shell & hygiene contract tests (`test_hooks_contract.py`), and isolated live `agy -p` E2E tests (`test_e2e_agy.py`). |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Matrix CI on `ubuntu-24.04` and `macos-latest` across Python `3.9` and `3.12`. |

### Invariants to preserve when enhancing

- **Stdlib-only Python 3.9+ runtime:** `scripts/model_guard.py` must import only Python 3.9 standard-library modules and run cleanly under `/usr/bin/python3 -I`.
- **Single repo seed, zero hardcoded runtime defaults:** Keep the initial seed exclusively in `scripts/default_config.json` (validated through the strict config parser) and never embed default model or effort strings in `scripts/model_guard.py`, `hooks.json`, `plugin.json`, or `rules/AGENTS.md` (enforced by `tests/test_hooks_contract.py`).
- **Native plugin layout:** Keep `hooks.json` at the plugin root using relative `./scripts/model_guard.py` (never `${PLUGIN_ROOT}`), keep the POSIX `sh` `|| printf` fail-closed fallback (non-zero hook exits fail open in Antigravity), and never add a root `AGENTS.md` (it triggers an `agy plugin validate --strict` multi-tool warning).
- **Security boundaries:** Preserve absolute, NUL-free `HOME` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` validation, `os.lstat` non-overwriting checks, `O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW` + `O_CREAT | O_EXCL` (`0o600`) + `os.link` atomic bootstrap, `O_NONBLOCK` + `fstat` regular-file config reads, bounded chunked stdin reads, `MAX_JSON_NUMBER_CHARS` protection against Python 3.9 quadratic integer parsing, closed duplicate-free JSON schema validation, and `"decision": "allow"` (never `"auto_approve"`).

### Local verification

Create a disposable virtual environment (so system/Homebrew Python stays untouched), install dev tools, and run all static, unit, contract, and isolated E2E checks:

```sh
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
python3 -m venv "$tmpdir/venv"
"$tmpdir/venv/bin/pip" install --upgrade pip
"$tmpdir/venv/bin/pip" install ruff mypy basedpyright pytest

# Static checks, strict typing, unit & POSIX sh contract tests, and agy plugin validate --strict
PATH="$tmpdir/venv/bin:$PATH" make check

# Isolated live agy -p E2E suite (uses temporary workspace + XDG_CONFIG_HOME; never modifies ~/.config or ~/.gemini)
PATH="$tmpdir/venv/bin:$PATH" make test-e2e

rm -rf "$tmpdir"
make clean
```

### Versioning & releasing

1. Bump `"version"` in **both** `plugin.json` and `pyproject.toml` following Semantic Versioning (`fix` → patch, `feat` → minor, breaking change → major); `tests/test_hooks_contract.py` verifies they stay in sync.
2. Run `make check` and `make test-e2e` cleanly, then commit with Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`) and push to `main`.
3. Confirm GitHub Actions CI passes across all matrix legs on `main`.
4. Create a signed tag (`git tag -s vX.Y.Z -m "vX.Y.Z" && git push origin vX.Y.Z`), publish a GitHub Release (`gh release create vX.Y.Z --title "vX.Y.Z" --notes "..."`), and verify remote strict validation (`agy plugin validate --strict https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model`).

`v1.2.0` extends `single-agy-model` with a fail-closed `PreToolUse` hook on `^invoke_subagent$` so subagent delegations—including Antigravity's built-in `browser` subagent, whose default prompt instructs agents to pass `Model: "flash"`—automatically inherit your locked SSOT model (`Model: "inherit"`) instead of failing `PreInvocation`.

## What's New

- **`PreToolUse` (`^invoke_subagent$`) coercion & guard:** Added `pre-tool-use-invoke-subagent` in `scripts/model_guard.py` and wired `^invoke_subagent$` in `hooks.json` with the same POSIX `sh` `|| printf` fail-closed fallback used by `^swarm$`. Calls already passing `Model: "inherit"` return `{"decision":"allow"}`; calls omitting `Model` or passing an alternate tier (`"flash"`, `"flash_lite"`, `"pro"`) are coerced in-flight via `{"decision":"allow","overwrite":{"Model":"inherit"}}` (handling both top-level args and batched `Subagents` arrays). Invalid/non-string/wrong-cased/unrecognized `Model` values, unexpected lowercase `model` overrides, malformed payloads, and invalid SSOT configs fail closed with `{"decision":"deny"}`.
- **Rules & documentation:** Updated `rules/AGENTS.md` and `README.md` to instruct agents to pass `Model: "inherit"` for `browser` and all other subagents and document the `^invoke_subagent$` hook.
- **Verification & security hardening:** Expanded unit, POSIX `/bin/sh` contract, and isolated live `agy -p` E2E tests (311 unit/contract tests + 5 E2E tests), tightened test `_tracking_open` default file modes to `0o600`, and enabled CodeQL Default Setup (`python` + `actions`, `extended`) with 0 open alerts.

## Install / Update

```sh
agy plugin validate --strict https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
agy plugin uninstall single-agy-model && agy plugin install https://github.com/rbeauchamp/single-agy-model
```
